title: Written complaint from a bereaved family member
proves: A written complaint in Bengali from the family of a deceased victim is read as extreme vulnerability, with grief and no means of support.
summary: A written complaint in Bengali from a woman whose husband was lost in the incident last year. The case is still going on. She now looks after three children and her elderly mother-in-law alone, has no income, and feels everything has become too heavy. She asks for financial help and legal aid.

paragraphs: গত বছর সেই ঘটনায় আমরা আমার স্বামীকে হারিয়েছি। সেই মামলা এখনও চলছে।
এখন আমি একা তিন সন্তান আর বৃদ্ধ শাশুড়িকে দেখাশোনা করি। আমাদের কোনো আয় নেই।
রাতে ঘুম আসে না, সারাদিন মন ভারী হয়ে থাকে। মনে হয় সবকিছু খুব ভারী হয়ে গেছে।
আমাদের আর্থিক সাহায্য আর আইনি সহায়তা দরকার।
gloss: Last year we lost my husband in that incident. That case is still going on.
Now I alone look after three children and my elderly mother-in-law. We have no income.
I cannot sleep at night and my heart stays heavy all day. It feels as if everything has become too heavy.
We need financial help and legal aid.
